title: Sluttish
summary: SLUT'TISH, adjective 1. Not neat or cleanly; dirty; careless of dress and neatness; disorderly; as a sluttish woman. 2. Disorderly; dirty; as a sluttish dress. 3. Meretricious. [Little used.]
